commands: set -eu; git fetch origin; git checkout main; git pull --ff-only origin main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c67752483b07ba88399c6e1e6940c33dd3a2f51f"; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); test "$MODEL" = "SM-S906B"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$TMP/db"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$TMP/db-wal" 2>/dev/null || true; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$TMP/db-shm" 2>/dev/null || true; MAX=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/db" 'select coalesce(max(timestamp),0) from signal_samples;'); START=$((MAX-900000)); echo WINDOW_MS=900000; echo FHN_TOTAL=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/db" "select count(*) from signal_samples where timestamp>=$START and beaconType='Google Find Hub';"); echo FHN_DISTINCT_FINGERPRINTS=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/db" "select count(distinct deviceFingerprint) from signal_samples where timestamp>=$START and beaconType='Google Find Hub';"); echo FHN_ANON_GROUPS; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/db" "with g as (select deviceFingerprint,count(*) samples,round(avg(rssi),1) avgRssi,min(rssi) minRssi,max(rssi) maxRssi,min(timestamp) firstTs,max(timestamp) lastTs,count(distinct serviceDataByUuidHex) payloadVariants from signal_samples where timestamp>=$START and beaconType='Google Find Hub' group by deviceFingerprint), r as (select row_number() over(order by avgRssi desc) n,samples,avgRssi,minRssi,maxRssi,firstTs,lastTs,payloadVariants from g) select printf('FHN-%02d',n) as anon,samples,avgRssi,minRssi,maxRssi,(lastTs-firstTs) as spanMs,payloadVariants from r order by n;"; echo CONCURRENCY_5S_BUCKETS; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/db" "with b as (select cast(timestamp/5000 as integer) bucket,count(distinct deviceFingerprint) n from signal_samples where timestamp>=$START and beaconType='Google Find Hub' group by bucket) select n as concurrentFingerprints,count(*) as buckets from b group by n order by n;"; echo FHN_STATUS_SUMMARY; sqlite3 -header -separator '|' "$TMP/db" "select trackingStatus,count(*) rows,round(avg(followingScore),1) avgScore from devices where beaconType='Google Find Hub' group by trackingStatus order by trackingStatus;"
